name: U Ryngkew
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. U Ryngkew commands highland forces as road surveys and recruitment extend crown authority. The defence of shared routes strengthens the assemblies’ position in negotiations over local consent. The University register proposes a connection to Pragjyotisha Hill Autonomy Charter. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
